map.输入流动资产与流动负债，计算营运资金净额，衡量企业短期可动用资金，适用于现金流规: Enter current assets and liabilities to compute net working capital, gauging short-term available funds—for cash-flow planning, liquidity management, and working-capital gap diagnosis.
map.营运资金 = 流动资产 − 流动负债: Working capital = current assets − current liabilities
map.输入流动资产与流动负债，求营运资金。: Enter current assets and liabilities to find working capital.
map.评估企业短期流动性余量，判断能否覆盖日常经营周转。: Assess short-term liquidity headroom and whether daily operations are covered.
map.扩张或接大单前，测算营运资金是否充足，避免资金链紧张。: Before expansion or big orders, check if working capital suffices to avoid strain.
map.监控营运资金随季节与账期波动，安排短期融资。: Monitor working-capital swings with season and terms to arrange short-term financing.
map.：某公司流动资产 800 万元、流动负债 400 万元，营运资金=800−400: : A company with current assets 800 (10k CNY) and liabilities 400 (10k CNY) has working capital = 800−400 = 400 (10k CNY), i.e., net funds freely schedulable for daily turnover.
map.营运资金为正就一定安全吗？: Is positive working capital always safe?
map.正营运资金说明流动资产覆盖流动负债，但若大量是滞销存货或难收应收，实际流动性仍可: Positive working capital means current assets cover liabilities, but if much is unsold inventory or hard-to-collect receivables, real liquidity may still be tight—check quick assets too.
map.营运资金为负怎么办？: What if working capital is negative?
map.负值意味着短期负债超过流动资产，依赖持续融资或加速回款维持；零售等强现金行业可短: Negative means short-term liabilities exceed current assets, relying on ongoing financing or faster collection; cash-heavy retail may run negative briefly, but most firms should improve terms.
